name: @zframes/provider-fx
description: Free keyless zframes data provider for foreign-exchange rates: latest rate, daily change, and a short trend per currency (fx-rates + dollar-index capabilities). Frankfurter (ECB daily reference rates) is the primary, with a keyless CORS-open fallback chain — FXRatesAPI, currency-api, then the ECB Data Portal itself — so an upstream outage can't silently revert every non-USD board to quoting USD.
author: Zentry
